name: updateCategoriesAdvanced
description: Changes several categories at once, up to 50.

categories.description: The categories to change and what to change on each, up to 50 at a time.

categoryId.description: The category's id, as shown in search results.

newTitle.description: The category's new name. Leave it out to keep the current one.

newIcon.description: Its new picture, as a list holding one image; it replaces a library icon. Leave it out to keep the current one, or pass an empty list to remove it.

newIconName.description: Its new icon from the icon library; it replaces a picture. Leave it out to keep the current one, or leave it empty to remove it.

callback.description: Runs when all the categories are done.

error.description: Why nothing was changed, such as an entry missing what it needs or naming something that doesn't exist.

result.description: How each of the categories went.

categories.description: One result per entry, in the order they were given.

index.description: Which entry this is, counting from 0.

id.description: The id of what was changed, if it was.

error.description: Why it wasn't changed, if it wasn't.
